text: The authors list distant supervision as another approach to scalable oversight: instead of evaluating a small fraction of a system's decisions, provide aggregate information or noisy hints about correct evaluations (e.g. generalized expectation criteria with population-level statistics, DeepDive rules generating weak labels). They suggest extending this to agents, where feedback is interactive and i.i.d. assumptions may fail, as complementary to semi-supervised RL.
title: Distant supervision as an approach to scalable oversight
